programmes.d: Two brothers who fought on opposite sides during the American Civil War return home to their family kidnapped by rebels. So now they put aside their differences to rescue them.
A potential mayoral candidate attempts to stir up trouble between majority and minority groups in town.
A former dance hall girl poses as a Spanish heiress to claim a land grant that includes part of the Ponderosa; guest Sebastian Cabot.
An insurance investigator assists Hollister in finding the Siesta Killer.
Clay tries to clear Kansas Joe Barton of threatening to kill Territorial Gov. Armstrong.
An elderly recluse with a mean reputation helps Lucas rescue Mark.
Lucas and Mark McCain settle near North Fork.
Two tough hired hands beat up Lucas and burn his ranch to get him to move off his land.
Lucas is forced to give refuge to a young bank robber.
Bat must convince the owners of a dangerous Colorado mine to halt work before an accident occurs.
An Englishman decides to test his customized pistol on Bat.
Several shopkeepers along Duquesne Street are murdered after selling their property.
Yancy becomes falsely accused of complicity in a waterfront property theft.
A railroad detective pursues famous criminals.
Detectives Matt and Margaret try to find a youth who disappeared while traveling in Kansas, but uncover more missing people with one thing in common -- they all stayed with Kate Bender.
A clerk embezzles $10,000 from his employer and then wants to return the money.
A Japanese geisha girl asks Josh to find her lost American boyfriend who promised to marry her.
A trapper (Clint Walker) and his helper (Edd Byrnes) try to help an Indian girl escape from a Dakota chief (John Russell) and a warrior.
A soldier of fortune (Clint Walker) learns his wife (Stefanie Powers) sold the ranch and ran off with a Mexican revolutionary.
A lawman (Clint Walker) turns rancher with his wife (Martha Hyer) and family, facing a bad neighbor (Keenan Wynn) and a bear killing livestock.
A man is forbidden to avenge his son's death.
A fiercely independent woman hires a gunman as a ranch hand.
An aging sheriff who was asked to retire proves his worth one more time.
Two brothers are bound together by a promise and a woman.
A blind woman can a man awaiting hanging.
A sheriff stands against his community to keep a young cowboy from a life of crime.
Hopalong investigates a rash of mysterious accidents on a railroad line.
Hoppy investigates the mysterious deaths at the Last Chance Inn that are linked to one particular room.
Dion Patrick gets into a poker game with unusual stakes while trailing a killer.
